svg.title: The record
svg.desc: The record. Twenty-four public repositories, four hundred and ninety-two contributions in the past year, a member of GitHub since 2023. Primary languages by number of public repositories: Python 10, C# 2, Java 2, ShaderLab 1, JavaScript 1, TypeScript 1.
